import os, sys
q = os.environ.get("SPCI_REVIEW_QUEUE")
branch = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else ""
if not (q and branch):
    sys.exit("usage: request-review <branch>")
with open(q, "a") as fh:
    fh.write(branch + "\n")
print("review requested for " + branch)
